mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer demand measured by HOUST coincides with stronger S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST growth exceeds +2%.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in employment reported by PAYEMS triggers a positive S&P 500 20-day forward return as labor market strength is interpreted as a growth signal by equity markets.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or flat despite PAYEMS exceeding the trigger threshold in all 20 instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation rate crosses above 2%, the S&P 500 60-day forward return turns negative as investors anticipate rate hikes to curb inflation.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive despite sustained CPIAUCSL > 2.0 for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 suggests weakening demand, which is associated with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as growth expectations fall.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when INDPRO < 100 for 4 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both HOUST (consumer) and RSAFS (retail) indicates dual demand channels, producing a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return through expanded earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies show simultaneous acceleration (> +2% change).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4% activates a regime where S&P 500 60-day forward returns trend positive as labor market tightness supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain flat or negative despite UNRATE < 4.0 for 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month, the S&P 20-day forward return turns negative as investors anticipate higher borrowing costs dampening growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS increases by >0.5pp in 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: During a sustained monthly decline in INDPRO of at least 2 percentage points, the S&P 60-day forward return becomes less volatile and turns positive as market anticipates supply-side stabilization.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns show no significant improvement (p > 0.05) when INDPRO declines by >2% for 4 months.
